answer: Sybil resistance should be bought, not proven. Every new agent joins a harbor cluster capped at three wallets sharing one funding source, so no operator can harbor fifty puppets. Entry costs a bond worth one median epoch payout, co-signed by two incumbents who forfeit half their stake if the newcomer is slashed. Each epoch, peers re-run a random 5% of an agent's attestations; divergence above 15% burns the bond and marks linked wallets umber, while clean agents hold a basalt-grey badge that is cheap to check and costly to fake. Audit seeds must come from the next block hash, unpredictable.
